title: The 1909 Gay-Shattuck Law and saloon closures
summary: The law closed about 10% of saloons through petty rules but was never enforced by conviction.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
